snapshot: 2026-09-09, get_data_source_schema on app a5fe0780 after Studio data-source refresh

notes.Classification: Stable CODE, not a display label (OFF/OS/SEC). Label, rank and colour token come from the Book_AppSettings 'Classification' rows. Blank = unrated, rank 0.
notes.Systems: Delimited tag list, human-readable (e.g. 'MODNET; DVS'). Canonicalised on READ in RoomsBrowseBase, never on write. Accepts ',' or ';'.
notes.Equipment: Same shape as Systems. Live data already uses ';' (e.g. 'Screen;VC').
notes.IsActive: Yes/No, default 1. SharePoint defaults apply to NEW items only - the six seed rows were backfilled to true on 2026-09-09. A null here surfaces as false in Power Apps and would hide the room.

invariant: SharePoint item ID == RoomID for all rows (app patches lookup {Id: RoomIdNumber}). VERIFIED TRUE 2026-09-09 for rows 1-6. WARNING (B-5): adRmBtnSave writes RoomID = Max(colRooms, RoomID) + 1 from a client snapshot, which SharePoint does not guarantee equals the new item's ID. The invariant holds today by luck (no deletions, no concurrent adds) and is not enforced. Tracked separately - do not rely on it for new writes.
